title: Twisted bilayer graphene: moiré bands unfolded onto the graphene zone
summary: The commensurate (3,2) cell of twisted bilayer graphene (76 atoms, 13.17°) with a distance-dependent EDTB model of carbon: moiré bands folded in the supercell zone and unfolded onto the zone of the bilayer cell, first with dense diagonalisation, then with the sparse shift-invert Lanczos solver meant for large moiré cells. Two more scripts unfold the AA (4,3) supercell with the sparse solver, and compute the bands and the Dirac velocity of the (4,3) and (6,5) twisted cells. No DFT run.

steps.label: Moiré cell, bands and unfolding (dense solver)
steps.note: (n, m) = (3, 2): 76 atoms, 13.17°; writes geom_tbg_*.json, Carbon_tbg_3_2/ and the figures tbg_3_2_*.png; about 3 minutes (4 MPI ranks are not faster at this size)

steps.label: The same with the sparse Lanczos solver
steps.note: joblib workers within the core budget (LOKY_MAX_CPU_COUNT caps them); the 120 bands nearest the Dirac point; writes Carbon_tbg/, Carbon_tbg_3_2_sparse/ and tbg_3_2_*_sparse.png; under a minute with 4 workers
